name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Brighter Day Saunas offer a product with various benefits to meet any customer’s demands: each unit will be a personal health spa at home, ready to use any time to help with sore muscles and joints, detoxification and skin purification, stress relief and relaxation.



Each unit is equipped with easy to use controlling system and a special seven year Manufacturer's Warranty. There is no need for a long and hard installing process for each of the units, the assembly process is very easy and fast – prefabricated panels are easily snapped into position within 30 minutes of time – and at the end all you have to do is plug the Infrared Sauna into any 120 V/15-Amp outlet and you can start using the sauna.



The units are constructed with great sympathy for the planet and greatly save energy – a 30 minute sauna session will cost less than using a hair dryer! Among the other benefits of Brighter Day Sauna units is the easy control system with a precise timer (up to 90 minutes) and a special Reading light that will help to enjoy the relaxing session with a book or a magazine to ease the passing of time
